description: Held-out retrieval test set for the embedding fine-tune. Written by hand from backend/data before any training data was generated, then frozen (see test_queries.sha256). Questions use synonyms and indirect, salesperson-style phrasing and avoid the target text's keywords where possible. 'relevant' lists every chunk source_id that states the answer. 'user' is the persona whose access filter is applied in the filtered setting; t-ae-na is a test-only AE for NA-East (no NA-East user exists in users.json). style: indirect = account not named, named = account named, product = product documentation.
